environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) with public internet-facing listener on port 443. The ALB forwards traffic directly to the container on port 8080. No WAF rules attached. Backend service (internal-backend) is an Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 running on a separate ECS task in the same VPC. Security group allows all TCP from ALB security group. The ALB does NOT normalize or strip conflicting Transfer-Encoding/Content-Length headers.
